items.title: Make diagnostic help side-effect free
items.insight: Both run-doctor and verify-clean-checkout ignore --help. Usage lookup starts probes or worktree verification; mutation flags can write status or invoke remediation.
items.evidence: Both help aliases exit 0 with accurate usage, with no subprocesses or writes, including alongside --fix --loop --update-json --json --self-test and --keep --ref --from. Existing self-tests pass and normal CLI execution still crosses the probe boundary.
